about_short_description.short_description: SnapEDA provides an online library of electronic component CAD models and design resources for engineers and designers.

product.name: SnapMagic Search
product.description: A platform providing access to millions of free PCB footprints and schematic symbols for electronic components, compatible with various PCB design tools.

product.name: Component Request Service
product.description: A service where users can request creation of PCB footprints or schematic symbols not found in the library, fulfilled by SnapEDA engineers or via an automated tool.

product.name: Automated Footprint Verification
product.description: A patented technology that performs real-time automated checks on PCB footprints to assess manufacturability and prevent design errors.
